race.description: Barbagallo Italian Fireworks This Friday Night Conditioned Hcp Ss Trot
race.comment: ALDEBARAN BOYD (6) resumes from a spell of five months after closing off last campaign in good form, recording a string of top-three results including a hat trick of wins at this venue. Starts from the 40m mark but has performed well from big handicaps before. BEE BEE BEROC (1) was beaten less than 5m into fifth from the 20m mark at his latest appearance. Recorded two wins from this mark along with two placings from the previous four starts so is worth another chance. MYSTERY FRED (7) has come from bigger handicaps since winning from this mark three back and owns a good strike rate at this circuit and distance. MY LIGHTNING MCQUEEN NZ (5) will strip fitter second up so can progress.
